capabilities: create forms from Obsidian via ribbon icon or folder context menu
build and edit form questions on the linked website
publish forms to the web for others to fill in
receive form submissions as notes in a vault folder
extras: Freemium: one form is free; more forms require $6 per year or a one-time $10 lifetime deal. Form creation and question editing happen on the external website, not inside Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to collect structured input from other people, such as surveys or intake forms, into vault notes.

requires.name: paid plan for publishing more than one form

summary: Form builder that publishes web forms and delivers each submission into a chosen folder in the vault.
